summary: Jennifer Orr, 43, of Wichita, Kansas, was killed when her 2014 Jeep Wrangler went off the shelf-road section in the rock-slide area of Iron Chest trail (Iron Chest Road from CR 295) above St. Elmo at over 11,000 feet and fell about 600 feet down the mountain; she was pronounced dead at the scene. Her daughter, a passenger in the vehicle, was flown by helicopter to a hospital in Pueblo. The family dog, thrown from the vehicle in the crash, was later found alive. Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery, with CORE and the US Forest Service, scouted the wreck on Aug 11 and recovered the vehicle over a multi-day operation; a Chaffee County SAR North member assisted with communications.
location: Iron Chest Road (from CR 295), above St. Elmo
notes: Date pinned to 2018-08-07: the Tuesday of the Hays Post's Aug 9, 2018 report and the CORE repost's "On August 7th". Helicopter operator for the daughter's transport not named in sources found. Resolves the "Iron Chest fatal" lead from the Sept 2022 Walden Destroyed FJ mission report. Merged 2026-09-15: CO4x4RnR mission report (parent-verified) covers the Aug 11-18 vehicle recovery and the family dog search; SAR element limited to a Chaffee County SAR North comms assist.
